lede: Counter-Strike 2 is the day's clearest cross-feed signal, turning up in two places with real money behind it: 1,206,781 concurrent players on Steam, and the PGL Major Singapore playoffs trading on Polymarket, where the Astralis versus Imperial match alone drew roughly $1.45M in 24-hour volume. Wikipedia went its own way, sending 385,182 readers to Joe Milton, its most-viewed article by a wide margin. The heavier story crossed Hacker News and Lemmy at once: a group of state attorneys general suing SpaceX's X and xAI over Grok generating child sexual abuse and non-consensual images.

throughlines.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
throughlines.gist: State attorneys general are suing SpaceX's X and xAI to stop Grok from producing child sexual abuse images and non-consensual sexual content; the filing surfaced on Hacker News and Lemmy the same day.
